Title: Speaker failure
Failure mode: Speaker fails and the audible alarm is silent
Cause: Open circuit of the speaker element or a blocked sound port
Hazardous situation: An occlusion or low battery alarm is shown on the display but is not heard during sleep
Harm: Hyperglycemia progressing to diabetic ketoacidosis
Risk control measures: RCM_ALM_01 Speaker self test by current sensing with redundant vibration annunciation [protective measure, verification PASS, credited P2 D2]
Design specification references: HDS_002 section 7.1 (DFC_ALM_01); REQ_ALM_001 at HDS_002 section 7.1

Title: Alarm not perceived
Failure mode: Alarm volume is insufficient for the user to perceive the alarm
Cause: Low volume setting or the pump is muffled under clothing and bedding
Hazardous situation: A no delivery alarm sounds but is not heard and delivery remains stopped
Harm: Sustained hyperglycemia requiring medical intervention
Risk control measures: RCM_ALM_02 Escalating alarm volume with repeated vibration until acknowledged [protective measure, verification PASS, credited P2]
Design specification references: HDS_002 section 7.1 (DFC_ALM_02); REQ_ALM_002 at HDS_002 section 7.1

Title: False high glucose drives automated correction
Failure mode: Falsely high glucose reading is used for automated correction
Cause: Sensor compression artifact or calibration error passes without a plausibility check
Hazardous situation: Automated correction delivers insulin against a false high reading
Harm: Severe hypoglycemia with seizure, loss of consciousness or death
Risk control measures: RCM_CGM_01 Rate of change plausibility filter with a cap on automated correction doses [protective measure, verification PASS, credited P2]; RCM_IFU_06 Labeling that instructs fingerstick confirmation before large corrections [information for safety, verification PASS, credited P1]
Verification evidence: VER_CGM_001 PASS TR_0150; VER_LBL_006 PASS TR_0155
Design specification references: UCS_004 section 4.2 (DFC_CGM_01); REQ_CGM_001 at UCS_004 section 4.2; REQ_LBL_006 at UCS_004 section 5.1

Title: Charger isolation failure
Failure mode: Isolation between the charging port and patient accessible parts fails
Cause: Use of a damaged or counterfeit USB power source while the pump is worn
Hazardous situation: Mains voltage reaches the enclosure while the pump is connected to the patient
Harm: Electric shock
Risk control measures: RCM_CHG_01 Reinforced isolation between the charging port and patient accessible parts [inherent safety by design, verification PASS, credited P1]
Design specification references: HDS_002 section 6.3 (DFC_CHG_01); REQ_CHG_001 at HDS_002 section 6.3

Title: Unauthorized remote bolus command
Failure mode: Unauthorized remote bolus command is accepted
Cause: Weak pairing authentication is exploited by an attacker within radio range
Hazardous situation: A third party triggers insulin delivery without the knowledge of the user
Harm: Severe hypoglycemia with seizure, loss of consciousness or death
Risk control measures: RCM_COM_01 Authenticated encrypted pairing with keys generated per session [inherent safety by design, verification PASS, credited P1]; RCM_COM_02 Remote bolus requires confirmation on the pump [protective measure, verification PENDING, credited P0 D0]
Verification evidence: VER_COM_001 PASS TR_0145; VER_COM_002 PENDING TR_0146
Design specification references: UCS_004 section 4.1 (DFC_COM_01); REQ_COM_001 at UCS_004 section 4.1; REQ_COM_002 at UCS_004 section 4.1

Title: Stale glucose data after connection loss
Failure mode: Connection to the glucose sensor is lost and glucose values stop updating
Cause: Radio interference or the transmitter is out of range
Hazardous situation: The user doses on a stale glucose value that no longer reflects the current level
Harm: Moderate hypoglycemia requiring assistance from another person
Risk control measures: RCM_COM_03 Stale data indicator with rejection of glucose values older than 15 minutes [protective measure, verification PASS, credited P2 D2]
Design specification references: UCS_004 section 4.1 (DFC_COM_02); REQ_COM_003 at UCS_004 section 4.1

Title: Corrupted setting change accepted
Failure mode: Corrupted data packet is accepted as a valid setting change
Cause: Insufficient message integrity checking
Hazardous situation: The basal profile is updated with corrupted values
Harm: Severe hypoglycemia with seizure, loss of consciousness or death
Risk control measures: RCM_COM_04 Message authentication code with range validation on all remote setting changes [inherent safety by design, verification PASS, credited P1]
Design specification references: UCS_004 section 4.1 (DFC_COM_03); REQ_COM_004 at UCS_004 section 4.1

Title: Continuous motor run from a shorted driver stage
Failure mode: Motor driver stage fails short and the motor runs continuously
Cause: Short circuit failure of a transistor in the H bridge driver stage
Hazardous situation: The pump delivers insulin continuously beyond the programmed dose while the patient is unaware
Harm: Severe hypoglycemia with seizure, loss of consciousness or death
Risk control measures: RCM_DRV_01 Independent motor power cutoff by the safety supervisor when encoder counts exceed commanded steps [protective measure, verification PASS, credited P1 D3]; RCM_MCU_03 Independent hourly delivery limit enforced by the safety supervisor [protective measure, verification PASS, credited P1]
Verification evidence: VER_DRV_001 PASS TR_0101; VER_MCU_003 PASS TR_0127
Design specification references: HDS_002 section 3.1 (DFC_DRV_01); REQ_DRV_001 at HDS_002 section 3.1; REQ_MCU_003 at SRS_003 section 3.2

Title: Motor stall without plunger advance
Failure mode: Motor stalls and the plunger does not advance
Cause: Loss of step torque from winding degradation or gear train wear
Hazardous situation: Programmed basal insulin is not delivered for several hours and no alarm is raised
Harm: Hyperglycemia progressing to diabetic ketoacidosis
Risk control measures: RCM_DRV_02 Encoder based stall detection with a no delivery alarm [protective measure, verification PASS, credited P2 D3]
Design specification references: HDS_002 section 3.1 (DFC_DRV_02); REQ_DRV_002 at HDS_002 section 3.1

Title: Plunger coupling disengagement and free flow
Failure mode: Plunger coupling disengages from the lead screw drive nut
Cause: Wear or fracture of the coupling latch
Hazardous situation: Reservoir contents siphon into the patient when the pump is held above the infusion site
Harm: Severe hypoglycemia with seizure, loss of consciousness or death
Risk control measures: RCM_DRV_03 Positive locking plunger coupling with retention force margin [inherent safety by design, verification PASS, credited P1]
Design specification references: HDS_002 section 3.2 (DFC_DRV_03); REQ_DRV_003 at HDS_002 section 3.2

Title: Lead screw backlash and dose inaccuracy
Failure mode: Lead screw backlash causes inaccurate delivery of small basal increments
Cause: Thread wear beyond tolerance over the service life
Hazardous situation: Delivered basal volume deviates from the programmed volume over an extended period
Harm: Transient hyperglycemia correctable by the user
Risk control measures: RCM_DRV_04 Closed loop plunger position correction using encoder feedback [protective measure, verification PASS, credited P2]
Design specification references: HDS_002 section 3.2 (DFC_DRV_04); REQ_DRV_004 at HDS_002 section 3.2

Title: Water ingress
Failure mode: Water enters the electronics compartment
Cause: Gasket damage after a drop or gasket ageing
Hazardous situation: Moisture short circuits the electronics and the pump stops delivery without a valid alarm
Harm: Hyperglycemia progressing to diabetic ketoacidosis
Risk control measures: RCM_ENC_01 IPX8 sealed enclosure with drop tested gasket retention [inherent safety by design, verification PASS, credited P2]; RCM_ENC_02 Moisture sensor that triggers an alarm and a transition to the safe state [protective measure, verification PASS, credited D2]
Verification evidence: VER_ENC_001 PASS TR_0122; VER_ENC_002 PASS TR_0123
Design specification references: HDS_002 section 7.2 (DFC_ENC_01); REQ_ENC_001 at HDS_002 section 7.2; REQ_ENC_002 at HDS_002 section 7.2

Title: Cracked enclosure
Failure mode: Enclosure cracks and exposes a sharp edge
Cause: Impact damage from a drop onto a hard surface
Hazardous situation: A sharp edge of the cracked case rubs against the skin during wear
Harm: Minor skin laceration or irritation
Risk control measures: RCM_ENC_03 Impact resistant polymer housing with rounded edge geometry [inherent safety by design, verification PASS, credited P1]
Design specification references: HDS_002 section 7.2 (DFC_ENC_02); REQ_ENC_003 at HDS_002 section 7.2

Title: Infusion set connector detachment
Failure mode: Infusion set connector detaches from the reservoir
Cause: Incomplete latch engagement or connector thread wear
Hazardous situation: Insulin is pumped onto skin or clothing instead of into the tissue and no alarm is raised
Harm: Hyperglycemia progressing to diabetic ketoacidosis
Risk control measures: RCM_IFU_04 Training on infusion site checks and routine glucose monitoring [information for safety, verification PASS, credited P1]; RCM_INF_01 Keyed connector with audible and tactile lock confirmation [inherent safety by design, verification PASS, credited P1]
Verification evidence: VER_LBL_004 PASS TR_0153; VER_INF_001 PASS TR_0112
Design specification references: HDS_002 section 5.2 (DFC_INF_01); REQ_LBL_004 at UCS_004 section 5.1; REQ_INF_001 at HDS_002 section 5.2

Title: Infusion set worn beyond the change interval
Failure mode: Instructions on the infusion set change interval are misunderstood
Cause: Ambiguous wording and low readability of the instructions
Hazardous situation: The infusion set is worn beyond the recommended interval
Harm: Infusion site infection
Risk control measures: RCM_LBL_01 Infusion site change reminder with configurable interval [protective measure, verification PASS, credited P2]; RCM_LBL_02 Instructions on set change interval validated for comprehension [information for safety, verification PASS, credited P1]
Verification evidence: VER_LBL_007 PASS TR_0156; VER_LBL_008 PASS TR_0157
Design specification references: UCS_004 section 5.1 (DFC_LBL_01); REQ_LBL_007 at UCS_004 section 5.1; REQ_LBL_008 at UCS_004 section 5.1

Title: Firmware hang during delivery
Failure mode: Main controller firmware hangs during delivery
Cause: Software deadlock or stack overflow
Hazardous situation: Delivery halts and the display freezes while no alarm is raised
Harm: Hyperglycemia progressing to diabetic ketoacidosis
Risk control measures: RCM_MCU_01 Hardware watchdog reset with system error alarm from the safety supervisor [protective measure, verification PASS, credited P2 D3]
Design specification references: SRS_003 section 3.1 (DFC_MCU_01); REQ_MCU_001 at SRS_003 section 3.1

Title: Corruption of the active delivery rate
Failure mode: Memory corruption alters the active delivery rate variable
Cause: Stray pointer write or radiation induced bit flip
Hazardous situation: The pump delivers at a rate many times higher than programmed
Harm: Severe hypoglycemia with seizure, loss of consciousness or death
Risk control measures: RCM_MCU_02 Critical variables stored in triplicate with voting and range check before each delivery [inherent safety by design, verification PASS, credited P1]; RCM_MCU_03 Independent hourly delivery limit enforced by the safety supervisor [protective measure, verification PASS, credited P1]
Verification evidence: VER_MCU_002 PASS TR_0126; VER_MCU_003 PASS TR_0127
Design specification references: SRS_003 section 3.1 (DFC_MCU_02); REQ_MCU_002 at SRS_003 section 3.1; REQ_MCU_003 at SRS_003 section 3.2

Title: Silent failure of the safety supervisor
Failure mode: Safety supervisor stops monitoring and the failure remains latent
Cause: Supervisor oscillator failure or supervisor firmware fault
Hazardous situation: A later drive fault is not intercepted because the independent monitor is inactive
Harm: Severe hypoglycemia with seizure, loss of consciousness or death
Risk control measures: RCM_MCU_04 Mutual heartbeat between main controller and safety supervisor with alarm on loss [protective measure, verification PASS, credited D3]
Design specification references: SRS_003 section 3.2 (DFC_MCU_03); REQ_MCU_004 at SRS_003 section 3.2

Title: Therapy settings revert to defaults
Failure mode: Therapy settings revert to factory defaults
Cause: Flash write interrupted by power loss
Hazardous situation: The pump resumes delivery with a default basal profile that does not match the prescription
Harm: Moderate hypoglycemia requiring assistance from another person
Risk control measures: RCM_MEM_01 Atomic settings writes with checksum and dual copies, with delivery blocked when settings are invalid [protective measure, verification PASS, credited P2 D2]
Design specification references: SRS_003 section 5.1 (DFC_MEM_01); REQ_MEM_001 at SRS_003 section 5.1

Title: Battery thermal runaway
Failure mode: Battery cell enters thermal runaway
Cause: Internal short circuit from a manufacturing defect or mechanical damage
Hazardous situation: The pump surface temperature rises rapidly while the pump is worn against the body
Harm: Skin burn
Risk control measures: RCM_PWR_01 Cell protection circuit with current, voltage and temperature cutoff [protective measure, verification PASS, credited P1]; RCM_PWR_02 Certified cells with incoming inspection and lot traceability [inherent safety by design, verification PASS, credited P1]
Verification evidence: VER_PWR_001 PASS TR_0113; VER_PWR_002 PASS TR_0114
Design specification references: HDS_002 section 6.1 (DFC_PWR_01); REQ_PWR_001 at HDS_002 section 6.1; REQ_PWR_002 at HDS_002 section 6.1

Title: Battery depletion without warning
Failure mode: Battery depletes suddenly without a low battery warning
Cause: Abrupt capacity loss of an aged cell or at low temperature
Hazardous situation: The pump shuts down during sleep and basal delivery stops for several hours
Harm: Hyperglycemia progressing to diabetic ketoacidosis
Risk control measures: RCM_PWR_03 Staged low battery alarms with reserved alarm capacity [protective measure, verification PASS, credited P1 D3]; RCM_PWR_04 Temperature compensated capacity estimation [inherent safety by design, verification PASS, credited P1]
Verification evidence: VER_PWR_003 PASS TR_0115; VER_PWR_004 PASS TR_0116
Design specification references: HDS_002 section 6.1 (DFC_PWR_02); REQ_PWR_003 at HDS_002 section 6.2; REQ_PWR_004 at HDS_002 section 6.2

Title: Fuel gauge overestimation
Failure mode: Fuel gauge overestimates the remaining battery capacity
Cause: Coulomb counter drift without recalibration
Hazardous situation: The displayed battery level stays normal until the pump shuts down abruptly
Harm: Hyperglycemia progressing to diabetic ketoacidosis
Risk control measures: RCM_PWR_05 Voltage based critical battery threshold independent of the coulomb counter [protective measure, verification PASS, credited P2 D1]
Design specification references: HDS_002 section 6.2 (DFC_PWR_03); REQ_PWR_005 at HDS_002 section 6.2

Title: Reservoir seal leak
Failure mode: Reservoir seal leaks insulin into the reservoir compartment
Cause: O ring compression set or a cracked reservoir barrel
Hazardous situation: Insulin leaks into the pump instead of reaching the patient while the dose counter still records delivery
Harm: Hyperglycemia progressing to diabetic ketoacidosis
Risk control measures: RCM_IFU_02 Instructions to inspect the reservoir compartment at every reservoir change [information for safety, verification MISSING, credited D0]; RCM_RSV_01 Validated seal compression design with a single use reservoir limit [inherent safety by design, verification PASS, credited P2]
Verification evidence: REQ_LBL_002 has no verification record; VER_RSV_001 PASS TR_0109
Design specification references: HDS_002 section 5.1 (DFC_RSV_01); REQ_LBL_002 at UCS_004 section 5.1; REQ_RSV_001 at HDS_002 section 5.1

Title: Air bubbles in the reservoir
Failure mode: Air bubbles in the reservoir are delivered in place of insulin
Cause: Incomplete priming or outgassing of cold insulin as it warms
Hazardous situation: Air displaces insulin in the infusion line during basal delivery
Harm: Transient hyperglycemia correctable by the user
Risk control measures: RCM_IFU_03 Illustrated instructions on priming and removal of air bubbles [information for safety, verification PASS, credited P1]; RCM_RSV_02 Guided priming sequence with user confirmation of fluid at the cannula tip [protective measure, verification PASS, credited P1]
Verification evidence: VER_LBL_003 PASS TR_0152; VER_RSV_002 PASS TR_0110
Design specification references: HDS_002 section 5.1 (DFC_RSV_02); REQ_LBL_003 at UCS_004 section 5.1; REQ_RSV_002 at HDS_002 section 5.1

Title: Loss of sterility of the fluid path
Failure mode: Sterile barrier of the reservoir package is breached before use
Cause: Pouch seal damage during distribution
Hazardous situation: A contaminated fluid path is connected to the subcutaneous tissue
Harm: Infusion site infection
Risk control measures: RCM_RSV_03 Validated sterile barrier packaging with integrity indicator [inherent safety by design, verification PASS, credited P1 D2]
Design specification references: HDS_002 section 5.1 (DFC_RSV_03); REQ_RSV_003 at HDS_002 section 5.1

Title: Clock loses time after battery change
Failure mode: Clock loses time after a battery change
Cause: Backup capacitor is depleted during a long battery change
Hazardous situation: The basal schedule is shifted relative to the true time of day
Harm: Transient hyperglycemia correctable by the user
Risk control measures: RCM_RTC_01 Clock validity check at power up that forces user confirmation of the time [protective measure, verification PASS, credited P2]
Design specification references: SRS_003 section 5.2 (DFC_RTC_01); REQ_RTC_001 at SRS_003 section 5.2

Title: Undetected downstream occlusion
Failure mode: Force sensor reads low and fails to detect a downstream occlusion
Cause: Strain gauge drift or delamination of the load cell
Hazardous situation: The infusion line is blocked and insulin is not delivered while no occlusion alarm sounds
Harm: Hyperglycemia progressing to diabetic ketoacidosis
Risk control measures: RCM_SNS_01 Force sensor plausibility self test at power on and every 24 hours [protective measure, verification PASS, credited D2]; RCM_SNS_02 Redundant occlusion inference from the motor current signature [protective measure, verification PASS, credited P2 D1]
Verification evidence: VER_SNS_001 PASS TR_0105; VER_SNS_002 PASS TR_0106
Design specification references: HDS_002 section 4.1 (DFC_SNS_01); REQ_SNS_001 at HDS_002 section 4.1; REQ_SNS_002 at HDS_002 section 4.1

Title: Unintended bolus on release of an occlusion
Failure mode: Occlusion clears suddenly and releases insulin accumulated in the line
Cause: Pressure stored behind a kinked cannula is released when the kink straightens
Hazardous situation: Stored insulin is delivered as an unintended bolus when the occlusion releases
Harm: Moderate hypoglycemia requiring assistance from another person
Risk control measures: RCM_IFU_01 Instructions directing the user to disconnect before clearing an occlusion [information for safety, verification PASS, credited P1]; RCM_SNS_03 Occlusion alarm threshold that limits stored volume, with plunger retraction on alarm [protective measure, verification PASS, credited P2]
Verification evidence: VER_LBL_001 PASS TR_0151; VER_SNS_003 PASS TR_0107
Design specification references: HDS_002 section 4.1 (DFC_SNS_02); REQ_LBL_001 at UCS_004 section 5.1; REQ_SNS_003 at HDS_002 section 4.1

Title: False occlusion alarms
Failure mode: Force sensor noise triggers occlusion alarms when no occlusion is present
Cause: Mechanical vibration and temperature change shift the force baseline
Hazardous situation: Delivery stops repeatedly for false occlusion alarms and the user delays restarting delivery
Harm: Transient hyperglycemia correctable by the user
Design specification references: HDS_002 section 4.1 (DFC_SNS_03)

Title: Encoder undercount
Failure mode: Encoder undercounts motor rotation
Cause: Contamination of the optical encoder disc
Hazardous situation: The controller commands extra motor steps to compensate and delivers more insulin than programmed
Harm: Severe hypoglycemia with seizure, loss of consciousness or death
Risk control measures: RCM_SNS_05 Supervisor cross check of encoder counts against commanded steps and motor current [protective measure, verification PASS, credited P1 D3]
Design specification references: HDS_002 section 4.2 (DFC_SNS_04); REQ_SNS_004 at HDS_002 section 4.2

Title: Excessive bolus recommendation
Failure mode: Bolus calculator recommends an excessive dose
Cause: Unit conversion defect between glucose units in the correction calculation
Hazardous situation: The user accepts a recommended bolus several times larger than needed
Harm: Severe hypoglycemia with seizure, loss of consciousness or death
Risk control measures: RCM_SW_01 Maximum bolus limit and confirmation screen showing the calculation inputs [protective measure, verification PASS, credited P1 D1]; RCM_SW_02 Glucose unit locked at setup with range validation of glucose entries [inherent safety by design, verification PASS, credited P2]
Verification evidence: VER_SW_001 PASS TR_0129; VER_SW_002 PASS TR_0130; VER_SW_003 PASS TR_0131
Design specification references: SRS_003 section 4.1 (DFC_SW_01); REQ_SW_001 at SRS_003 section 4.1; REQ_SW_002 at SRS_003 section 4.1; REQ_SW_003 at SRS_003 section 4.1

Title: Insulin on board not subtracted
Failure mode: Insulin on board is not subtracted from a correction bolus
Cause: Active insulin time is reset to default after a clock change or software update
Hazardous situation: Repeated correction boluses stack because earlier insulin is ignored
Harm: Moderate hypoglycemia requiring assistance from another person
Risk control measures: RCM_SW_03 Insulin on board persisted with integrity check and shown on the bolus screen [protective measure, verification FAIL, credited P0]
Verification evidence: VER_SW_004 PASS TR_0132; VER_SW_005 FAIL TR_0133
Design specification references: SRS_003 section 4.1 (DFC_SW_02); REQ_SW_004 at SRS_003 section 4.1; REQ_SW_005 at SRS_003 section 4.1

Title: Basal schedule applied to the wrong time segment
Failure mode: Basal schedule is applied to the wrong time segment
Cause: Scheduler handles a time zone or clock change incorrectly
Hazardous situation: The overnight basal rate is delivered during the day or the daytime rate overnight
Harm: Moderate hypoglycemia requiring assistance from another person
Risk control measures: RCM_SW_04 Clock change confirmation with basal schedule review prompt [protective measure, verification PASS, credited P2 D1]
Design specification references: SRS_003 section 4.2 (DFC_SW_03); REQ_SW_006 at SRS_003 section 4.2

Title: Suspended delivery does not resume
Failure mode: Suspended delivery does not resume when expected
Cause: State machine transition defect after alarm acknowledgment
Hazardous situation: The pump remains suspended after the user believes delivery has resumed
Harm: Hyperglycemia progressing to diabetic ketoacidosis
Risk control measures: RCM_SW_05 Persistent suspended indicator with periodic reminder alarm [protective measure, verification PASS, credited P1 D2]; RCM_SW_06 Automatic resume timer that bounds the maximum suspension period [inherent safety by design, verification PASS, credited P1]
Verification evidence: VER_SW_007 PASS TR_0135; VER_SW_008 PASS TR_0136
Design specification references: SRS_003 section 4.2 (DFC_SW_04); REQ_SW_007 at SRS_003 section 4.2; REQ_SW_008 at SRS_003 section 4.2

Title: Bolus command executed twice
Failure mode: Bolus command is executed twice
Cause: Duplicate command processing after a communication retry
Hazardous situation: A single bolus request delivers double the intended dose
Harm: Moderate hypoglycemia requiring assistance from another person
Risk control measures: RCM_SW_07 Unique command identifiers with idempotent execution and a bolus lockout interval [inherent safety by design, verification PASS, credited P1]
Design specification references: SRS_003 section 4.2 (DFC_SW_05); REQ_SW_009 at SRS_003 section 4.2

Title: High priority alarm suppressed
Failure mode: High priority alarm is suppressed by lower priority alarms in the queue
Cause: Priority inversion in alarm queue handling
Hazardous situation: An occlusion or no delivery condition is not annunciated
Harm: Hyperglycemia progressing to diabetic ketoacidosis
Risk control measures: RCM_SW_08 Preemptive priority based alarm scheduling [inherent safety by design, verification PASS, credited P1]
Design specification references: SRS_003 section 4.3 (DFC_SW_06); REQ_SW_010 at SRS_003 section 4.3

Title: Unintended bolus from accidental touch
Failure mode: Unintended touch or key activation starts a bolus
Cause: Pressure on the touchscreen in a pocket or during sleep
Hazardous situation: A bolus is started without the intent of the user
Harm: Severe hypoglycemia with seizure, loss of consciousness or death
Risk control measures: RCM_UI_01 Automatic screen lock with unlock gesture and two step bolus confirmation [inherent safety by design, verification PASS, credited P2]
Design specification references: UCS_004 section 3.1 (DFC_UI_01); REQ_UI_001 at UCS_004 section 3.1

Title: Decimal dose entry error
Failure mode: User enters a bolus dose with a misplaced decimal point
Cause: Ambiguous numeric entry format leads to a tenfold use error
Hazardous situation: A bolus ten times larger than intended is confirmed and delivered
Harm: Severe hypoglycemia with seizure, loss of consciousness or death
Risk control measures: RCM_IFU_05 Training module on bolus entry with knowledge check [information for safety, verification PASS, credited P1]; RCM_UI_02 Fixed decimal dose entry with maximum bolus limit and large dose warning [inherent safety by design, verification PASS, credited P2]
Verification evidence: VER_LBL_005 PASS TR_0154; VER_SW_001 PASS TR_0129; VER_UI_002 PASS TR_0142
Design specification references: UCS_004 section 3.1 (DFC_UI_02); REQ_LBL_005 at UCS_004 section 5.1; REQ_SW_001 at SRS_003 section 4.1; REQ_UI_002 at UCS_004 section 3.1

Title: Display unreadable
Failure mode: Display fails or becomes unreadable
Cause: Backlight failure or a cracked display panel
Hazardous situation: The user cannot read alarm text or verify bolus entries
Harm: Sustained hyperglycemia requiring medical intervention
Risk control measures: RCM_UI_03 Distinct audible alarm patterns per priority that allow response without the display [protective measure, verification PASS, credited P1]
Design specification references: UCS_004 section 3.1 (DFC_UI_03); REQ_UI_003 at UCS_004 section 3.1
